risks.risk: Rear suspension/true 'dual shock' may not exist; photo only clearly supports front suspension.
risks.proof: A photo showing the rear shock area (rear triangle) and/or a short video of the bike from the side showing rear suspension movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a front-suspension (single suspension) 26-inch MTB, not true dual-shock.

risks.risk: Brake performance may be weak (worn pads/rotors, misalignment, air in hydraulic lines, or cable stretch).
risks.proof: A short video: squeeze brake levers while stationary (front and rear), plus a close-up of brake pads/rotors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not guaranteed (assume service may be needed).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may be faulty (skipping gears, bent derailleur hanger, worn cassette/chain).
risks.proof: A video riding slowly and shifting through all gears (front and rear), plus close-ups of derailleur and chain condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears not guaranteed (assume at least adjustment/possible parts).

risks.risk: Tyre condition may be poor (dry rot, bald tread, frequent punctures).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyre tread and sidewalls (both tyres), and a photo of the inner tube/valve if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Frame size/rider fit may be wrong; 'Size 26' may refer only to wheel size, not frame size.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size marking (if any) and a measurement: seat tube length (center to top) and top tube length.
risks.if_unproven: Price for a generic 26-inch MTB without confirmed frame size suitability.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the frame branding/label (so we can confirm exact model/brand).
Show rear suspension area (if it is truly dual shock) with a side/rear photo and a short movement video.
Send a video test: brakes (front and rear) and shifting through all gears while pedaling.
Send close-ups of tyres (tread + sidewalls) and chain/derailleur.
Provide frame measurements (seat tube length and top tube length) or any size marking.
response.reason: From photo 0 we can only confirm it’s a 26-inch MTB with front suspension; the key claims (tyre quality, gears, brakes, and true dual-shock) are not verifiable without operation/test photos or videos. To price safely for Rivers pickups, we need proof of brake/gear working and whether it’s truly dual shock.
